functionalRequirement: For any systematic action, such as disputes aging process, a case activity will be generated, and the user who initiated the dispute case must be notified upon next logon.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must generate case activities for 100% of systematic actions, including disputes aging process, and notify the initiating user upon next logon.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to generate case activities and notify users, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must generate case activities and notify users within 500 milliseconds of the systematic action completion.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time generation of case activities and notifications, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must be able to recover from failures and ensure that case activities are generated and users are notified correctly for 99.9% of systematic actions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous and reliable operation, necessitating high fault tolerance.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The system must verify the identity of the user initiating the dispute case and ensure that only authorized users can generate case activities.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user-initiated actions, which require authentication and authorization to prevent unauthorized access.

functionalRequirement: System shall read initialization data to derive definitions of heating and cooling units.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately derive definitions of heating and cooling units from initialization data for 100% of valid inputs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to read initialization data and derive definitions, necessitating precise and correct processing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 20 MB of memory to process initialization data and derive definitions of heating and cooling units.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR’s focus on processing initialization data.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Faultlessness: The system must be able to process initialization data and derive definitions of heating and cooling units without errors for 99.99% of valid inputs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes reliable operation, necessitating high faultlessness.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must allow for easy modification of initialization data and definitions of heating and cooling units, with a maximum modification time of 2 hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves processing initialization data, which may require modifications, necessitating easy modifiability.

functionalRequirement: The website shall provide forms for certificates so users can request certificates online.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The website must provide forms for certificates that cover 100% of the required certificate types.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the website to provide forms for certificates, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Appropriateness Recognizability: The website must provide clear and concise instructions for requesting certificates online, with a minimum user satisfaction rating of 90%.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction with the website, which should be easy to use and understand.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The website must process certificate requests within 2 seconds of submission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time processing of certificate requests, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The website must encrypt user data submitted for certificate requests using TLS 1.3.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive user data, which requires protection.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to manage privacy settings such as who can view their profile, connections, and sharing data with third parties.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately implement user privacy settings for 100% of valid inputs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to manage user privacy settings, necessitating precise and correct processing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear and intuitive interface for managing privacy settings, with a minimum user satisfaction rating of 90%.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction with the system, which should be easy to use and understand.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure that user privacy settings are not modified without explicit user consent.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive user data, which requires protection and integrity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to manage user privacy settings for 99.95% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to user privacy settings, necessitating high availability.

functionalRequirement: System shall set over temperature values to prevent temperature deviations beyond 3 degrees Fahrenheit.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must set over temperature values for 100% of temperature-controlled units.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to set over temperature values, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must set over temperature values within 100 milliseconds of temperature deviations exceeding 3 degrees Fahrenheit.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time monitoring and control of temperature deviations, requiring timely responses for effectiveness.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must be able to recover from failures and ensure that over temperature values are set correctly for 99.9% of temperature-controlled units.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous and reliable operation, necessitating high fault tolerance.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operational Constraint: The system must prevent temperature deviations beyond 3 degrees Fahrenheit to ensure safe operation of temperature-controlled units.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves safety-critical temperature control, which requires strict operational constraints to prevent accidents.
